'''Living Fires''' were entities summoned by the [[Prophet of Vodal Kressh|prophet]] of the [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]] [[Vodal Kressh]] within his [[Tomb of Vodal Kressh|tomb]]. The prophet summoned the entities to aid him when a strike team was sent to gather [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] artifacts from the tomb and attacked [[Gender/Legends|him]]. The [[Fire/Legends|fire]], along with the prophet were defeated by the team, however, and slain.
